subject: Workplace Skills
title: Overcoming Networking Anxiety
description: A fast breakdown of Overcoming Networking Anxiety for builders.

hook.text: A survey found that 65% of professionals avoid networking events due to anxiety. You're not alone in this.

buildup.text: Networking anxiety comes from fear of rejection, feeling like an impostor, or not knowing what to say.

discovery.text: Reframe networking as learning, not selling. When you approach people to learn about their work, anxiety drops.

twist.text: Most people at networking events feel the same anxiety. The person who says hello first is everyone's relief.

climax.text: Set a small goal: meet two new people, ask one good question each. Small wins build confidence over time.

punchline.text: Everyone's nervous. Be the one who says hello.

quiz.question: What's the most effective way to reduce networking anxiety?
options: Avoid events and network exclusively online
Reframe networking as learning about others rather than selling yourself
Only attend events where you already know people
